items.problem: Fresh-session repository memory and focused handoffs.
items.done_when: Memory CLI and mutation tests pass; root startup route and module cards resolve; CI result remains separate.
items.evidence_note: memory entry and scoped pack implementation

hosted.scope: Memory structure, behavior tests, frontend syntax; not installer delivery or Rust crash safety

items.problem: Unify update, initialization and rollback under recoverable promotion.
items.done_when: Crash-inject every promotion phase; restart repeatedly; source/build either old or new together; recovery failures block mutations and are visible.
items.evidence_note: Shared coordinator, 17 promotion boundaries across initialize/update/rollback/repair plus recovery interruption matrix. Rust execution pending hosted CI; do not mark passed from Python checks.

items.problem: Finish repeatable installer delivery, including correct workspace output paths.
items.done_when: Collect installer from cargo metadata target_directory; verify downloadable artifact and clean Windows install; commit generated Cargo.lock and pin validated tool versions.

items.problem: Wire task-scoped game memory into the desktop Chat Pack button.
items.done_when: Bootstrap a separate game identity; select task/module without file hunting; pack exact source hashes, selected source, dependency cards and explicit omissions; request missing assets instead of guessing.
items.evidence_note: create_chat_pack currently walks the whole managed project

items.problem: Bound worker execution and serialize workspace writers.
items.done_when: Parent-enforced timeouts terminate worker trees; capture bounded logs; no overlapping initialize/apply/rollback/context snapshot; simulate crash and lock contention.
items.evidence_note: run_godot; run_exported_smoke use Command::output; SAFE-1 now locks initialize/apply/rollback/context/launch requests; parent-enforced worker-tree deadlines still open.

items.problem: Validate incoming ZIPs against malicious and ambiguous paths.
items.done_when: Tests reject oversized/duplicate ZIP entries, overlapping ops, case aliases, reserved Windows names, traversal, links/reparse targets, and changed payloads between verification and apply.

items.problem: Use immutable revision identities and safe save-schema transitions.
items.done_when: After rollback, divergent reapply cannot reuse stale source/build snapshots. Never overwrite user saves; old executable cannot silently load incompatible new saves.
items.evidence_note: New operations retain unique transaction before-images and reject corrupt rollback snapshots. Save-schema compatibility and older ambiguous history migration remain open.

items.problem: Bind runtime execution to the verified manifest and document trust boundary.
items.done_when: Require the chosen worker, partner executable and templates in a nonempty manifest; reject extra executable selection. Document that trusted code still executes with local privileges.
items.evidence_note: integrity_at validates listed entries but worker_at selects by filename

items.problem: Separate current playable health from most recent attempted validation.
items.done_when: Rejecting a new candidate does not mislabel unchanged current build; show build evidence revision and outstanding recovery separately.
items.evidence_note: pipeline_ready reads last_validation.passed without matching report revision; SAFE-1 now forces not-ready while a recovery journal/error remains.
